leadText:
Mrs. Bellows (Japanese: オタネ Otane) is a character of the day who appeared in The Psychic Sidekicks!. She is a resident of Len Town. 

When , , and came along with Cherry to Len Town, Mrs. Bellows's suddenly ed itself in front of Ash. Mrs. Bellows was angry of her Abra for doing so, but Cherry complimented Mrs. Bellows's Abra of its cuteness. Abra continued to teleport itself onto other people's heads, making Mrs. Bellows even more angry.

Abra later teleported itself into a tree, and just as Mrs. Bellows spotted it, appeared with a giant robot. Mrs. Bellows ordered her Abra to use on it, but the mecha's glass eye simply deflected the attack. After that, Team Rocket used the robot's giant tongue to capture Mrs. Bellows's Abra.

When Team Rocket rolled into Len Town with their robot, destroyed the robot's cage holding the stolen Pokémon with its attack. Mrs. Bellows's Abra was freed and safely teleported itself into Mrs. Bellows's arms.
